notes:
Account summary:
- Company: large digital media archive, strong focus on 20–50 year back-catalog of long-form journalism and broadcast transcripts. Avg doc length: 2k-12k words (many very long). Estimated corpus for POC: 10M documents (projected production 30–60M).
- Primary problem: make archival content discoverable for editorial workflows and research queries. Need high recall + precise ranking for short editorial queries and long-form exploratory queries.
- Core stack preference: hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense embeddings) + cross-encoder reranker for top-K refinement. Want to avoid expensive reranker over large candidate sets.

Technical/requirements notes (from SE calls):
- Indexing scale: production expected 30–60M doc records after chunking. Need guidance on index sizing, shard planning, and incremental reindex.
- Chunking strategy discussed: two-tier chunking. 1) coarse split into ~2k-token chunks (merge paragraphs; preserve sentence boundaries). 2) micro-chunks for reranker context: 256–512 token windows with 128 token overlap for long results shown to editors. Overlap tuned to preserve answer continuity.
- Embeddings pipeline: embed at ingestion; considering 1536-d float32 -> quantize to int8/float16 for storage. Want recommendations from Redwood Optimize on tradeoffs.
- Candidate retrieval: HNSW/FAISS for ANN, canonical BM25 fallback for name/title queries. Target: retrieval latency P95 < 50ms for ANN query when run on dedicated nodes.
- Reranker tuning: prefer cross-encoder family (small-med) fine-tuned on editorial q/a pairs. Target reranker latency P95 <= 250ms for top-10 candidates; cost-per-query target <= $0.02 end-to-end (embedding retrieval + rerank averaged).
- Quality metrics: prioritize MRR@10 and R@100. Initial baseline: BM25 MRR@10=0.12; target with dense+rerank MRR@10>0.30.
- Caching & batching: aggressive prefix caching for repeated editorial queries; batching for embedding generation during ingest and reingest windows. Redwood suggested KV/prefix cache for recurring queries (editor templates).
- Security/compliance: must run in customer-controlled datacenter (on-prem) or private VPC. SOC2 and ISO27001 required; full audit logging and KMS integrations mandatory.

POC plan and asks (AE/SE notes):
- POC deliverables: ingest 10M doc subset, demonstrate 2 retrieval configurations (BM25+emb + tuned reranker) with dashboarded MRR/R@100 and latency breakdowns. Provide cost model for 10M -> 60M scale.
- SE work: provide chunking script (python) with options for tokenizers, overlap, and metadata carry-forward. Provide quantization recommendation (int8 vs float16) and expected storage savings.
- Ops asks: timeline for on-prem installer (approx weeks), supported HW profiles (DGX, A100, H100), and per-node throughput expectations.
- Quote from CTO: "Can only accept reranker P95 <= 250ms, otherwise we fallback to dense-only with editorial flag."
- Risk flags: storage & I/O cost at 60M+ chunks; reranker op cost at peak editorial traffic; longer-term interest in nearline cold storage for rarely accessed months.

Next steps (short):
- Send detailed POC statement of work with ingest steps + sample cost models (AE) — due 2026-03-15.
